title: What is a breadboard?
summary: Which holes are connected inside the board.

steps.text: This is a breadboard. You push wires and parts into its holes. Metal strips inside the board connect some holes together, so you never need to solder.
Move your mouse over any hole. The holes that light up in blue are connected to it inside the board. Try a few rows.
Each row has two strips of 5 holes: a-e on the left and f-j on the right. The channel in the middle separates them. Click a hole that is connected to the yellow hole 30c.

expect.hint: Connected holes are in the same row (30) and on the same side of the channel (columns a-e).
expect.success: Yes! 30a-30e are one strip. 30f-30j would be a different strip, across the channel.

steps.text: The long lines along the edges are power rails: every hole along one line is connected, top to bottom. Click any hole on the right − rail, next to the blue line.

expect.hint: It's the outermost line of holes on the right side, next to the blue stripe.
expect.success: Right. Projects use this rail for GND (ground), so every part can reach it easily.
